issue.name: SQL injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection occurs when untrusted user input is directly concatenated into a dynamic SQL query.
issue.remediationBackground: Use parameterized prepared statements or an ORM to bind parameters safely.
issue.remediationDetail: Ensure the product search endpoint uses parameterized SQL queries.
issue.issueDetail: The parameter 'q' was determined to be vulnerable to UNION-based SQL injection.

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected cross-site scripting occurs when user input is echoed directly into an HTML response without proper sanitization.
issue.remediationBackground: Encode all user-supplied data before rendering it into the HTML document context.
issue.remediationDetail: Sanitize the message parameter using contextual output encoding.
issue.issueDetail: The parameter 'message' was reflected unescaped in the server response.

issue.name: CORS misconfiguration
issue.issueBackground: The server reflects arbitrary Origin headers with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
issue.remediationBackground: Only allow trusted origin domains in CORS configurations.
issue.remediationDetail: Remove wildcard or unvalidated Origin reflection.
issue.issueDetail: The application returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://attacker.example.com with credentials allowed.
